summary: Registered the open question behind the authority-transition finding instead of leaving it only in a limitations list: a necessary gap under that investigation asking whether a removed or non-member sender can repeat the TimeoutNow trigger so that leadership churn persists over consecutive rounds, and whether the cluster reaches a stable leader between attempts under the same isolation the single-trigger measurement used. The investigation's discriminator now names the same question, since the source path places no restriction on repeated requests while only one displacement has been measured. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changed; with the remaining run time too short for a new harness and receipt, this keeps the next judgment-changing step precise.
